command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

PKG=mtr
REPO_DIR=/srv/localrepo/x86_64
HOST=dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org

echo "== STEP 1: baseline =="
cp /etc/apk/repositories /etc/apk/repositories.bak
cat /etc/apk/repositories

echo "== STEP 2: fetch package + deps into local storage while network is up =="
mkdir -p "$REPO_DIR"
apk update
apk fetch -R -o "$REPO_DIR" "$PKG"
ls -la "$REPO_DIR"

echo "== STEP 3: build local repo index (unsigned) =="
cd "$REPO_DIR"
apk index -o APKINDEX.tar.gz ./*.apk
ls -la "$REPO_DIR"

echo "== STEP 4: serve repo over HTTP on node's own IP =="
pkill -f "busybox httpd -f -p .*8080" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
busybox httpd -f -p "$NODE_IP:8080" -h /srv/localrepo &
disown
sleep 1
curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "local repo http_code=%{http_code}\n" "http://$NODE_IP:8080/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz"

echo "== STEP 5: make the usual remote repo unreachable =="
cp /etc/hosts /etc/hosts.bak
echo "240.0.0.1 $HOST" >> /etc/hosts
echo "-- remote reachability after block --"
curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "remote http_code=%{http_code}\n" "https://$HOST/alpine/v3.23/main/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz" || echo "REMOTE_UNREACHABLE (expected)"

echo "== STEP 6: point apk exclusively at local repo =="
printf 'http://%s:8080\n' "$NODE_IP" > /etc/apk/repositories
cat /etc/apk/repositories

echo "== STEP 7: refresh index from local repo only, install package =="
apk update --allow-untrusted
apk add --allow-untrusted "$PKG"

echo "== STEP 8: verify install =="
apk info -e "$PKG" && echo "PKG_INSTALLED_OK"
which mtr
mtr --version || true

echo "== STEP 9: restore repositories + hosts to original (cleanup), keep installed pkg and local repo data on disk =="
cp /etc/apk/repositories.bak /etc/apk/repositories
cp /etc/hosts.bak /etc/hosts
cat /etc/apk/repositories

echo "== STEP 10: confirm remote reachable again and pkg still installed after restoring config =="
curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "remote restored http_code=%{http_code}\n" "https://$HOST/alpine/v3.23/main/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz"
apk info -e "$PKG" && echo "PKG_STILL_INSTALLED"
ls -la /srv/localrepo/x86_64

echo "DONE"
